description:
[Personal research only] Side-by-side comparison of 2-6 stocks as one table: TTM revenue and growth, pretax margin, net income
growth and diluted EPS growth from SEC filings (each row's window ends on its ttm_to), net debt for
standard layouts, delayed price, day change, distance from the 52-week high and trend, market cap, and
P/E on filed diluted EPS LTM (FY + YTD - prior YTD). `order` lists each filed figure highest first, P/E
lowest first. `comparability` says what revenue means per layout; cell_notes say what moves a figure.
Filings are cited by accession in sources.edgar: open
https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/{cik}/{accession without dashes}/.

Personal research only: on every plan, this tool's output is for your own personal, non-commercial research. Do not use it in a commercial product, client deliverable or service.
